description.zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

- SkillId：Skill ID，精确匹配

- SkillName：Skill 名称。

- MatchType：匹配类型，控制 SkillName  的匹配类型，取值 exact(精确)/prefix(前缀)/fuzzy(模糊)

- Keyword： 关键词匹配 Skill 名称或 Skill 描述，模糊匹配。

- SkillLabels： Skill 标签集， 模糊匹配。
description.en:
The filter name. You can specify one or more names for the query. Valid values:

- SkillId: the skill ID. Exact match.

- SkillName: the skill name.

- MatchType: the match type that controls how SkillName is matched. Valid values: exact, prefix, and fuzzy.

- Keyword: keyword match against the skill name or skill description. Fuzzy match.

- SkillLabels: the skill label set. Fuzzy match.

description.zh: 过滤器值列表。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The list of filter values. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.
The number of entries per page.

description.en: Specifies whether to include the download URL for the skill package.

title.zh: 查询公开 Skill 列表

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请先确认服务商在创建服务时开启变配功能并完成变配参数设置。
descriptions.en:
### Before you begin
Make sure the service provider has enabled the specification change feature and completed the specification change parameter settings when creating the service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest list-public-skills --filter '[{"Value":["s-xxxxx"],"Name":"SkillId"}]' --next-token AAAAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4= --max-results 20 --need-download-url false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenest ListPublicSkills --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'AAAAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4=' --Filter.1.Value.1 's-xxxxx' --MaxResults 20 --NeedDownloadUrl false --Filter.1.Name SkillId
